Container.Name: postfach
Container.Overview: Postfach: a self-hosted remote MCP server that lets Claude search, read, triage and draft email in your IMAP mailboxes, with optional sending. Publish it through SWAG at https://postfach.yourdomain and add https://postfach.yourdomain/mcp as a custom connector in claude.ai. Accounts are configured in /data/postfach.yaml.
Container.Requires: SWAG (or another TLS reverse proxy) on the same custom Docker network. The network name above (proxynet) must match SWAG's.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: postfach.yaml, SQLite database (audit, OAuth clients/tokens) and cookie keys. Back this up.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The HTTPS URL SWAG serves, without trailing slash, e.g. https://postfach.example.com. Used as OAuth issuer; the MCP endpoint is this URL + /mcp.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: 32 random bytes, base64. Generate: docker run --rm ghcr.io/lukasmerzorg/postfach-mcp generate-key. Keep a copy outside the server: without it, encrypted secrets cannot be read.

Config.Name: Owner username
Config.Description: Login on the OAuth consent page when connecting Claude.

Config.Name: Owner password hash
Config.Description: Argon2id hash (starts with $argon2id$). Generate: printf '%s' 'your long password' | docker run -i --rm ghcr.io/lukasmerzorg/postfach-mcp hash-password

Config.Name: Allow sending
Config.Description: Server-side send switch. Leave false to start read/draft-only; drafts can still be sent from your mail client.

Config.Name: Send allowlist
Config.Description: Optional: only allow these recipients, e.g. *@family.ch,boss@work.ch

Config.Name: Mailbox password 1
Config.Description: Referenced from postfach.yaml as password_env: POSTFACH_PRIVATE_PASSWORD. Rename or add more variables as needed, or use password_enc in postfach.yaml instead (values here are stored in plain text on the flash drive).

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Networks whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted (SWAG's Docker network). The default covers Docker bridge networks.

Config.Name: Static API token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for clients without OAuth (generate-token).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone (logs only; mail dates keep their own offsets).

Config.Name: LAN port (optional)
Config.Description: Not needed with SWAG on the same network. Only map it for testing on the LAN; never forward it on your router.
